audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Kled Level 2 and Level 6 and calls Levels 3, 4-5 and First item 'Skill', while the packet chart reads Kled / Skill / Garen / Garen / Skill / Garen / Garen and the 'why' strings beside them already say Garen takes over ('At level 3 your Q-silence and E take over', 'With your first item you win extended trades').
audit.why: Side tokens contradict both the packet and the prose on the same row, so the page concedes stages Garen wins at a 50.98% overall rate.
audit.corrected: Realigned the chart to the packet as one atomic group — content win[1..5], full phases[1..6].side/rating — Level 1 stays Kled's.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t prices Bear Trap on a Rope at 7s and never says what the downtime buys you.
audit.why: 7s is rank 5. At rank 1 it is 11s, which is the window the early lane actually runs on — dodge the trap and he cannot re-engage for nine seconds.
audit.corrected: Rewrote report[5].t with the rank-1 number and the window it opens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup mentions that Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants a shield on arrival, and nothing warns about the Violent Tendencies wind-up.
audit.why: Kled's R is not just a charge — it shields him and Skaarl rams the first champion it meets, so burst spent into it is wasted. And Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset giving four fast bites: the wind-up, not a cast animation, is the cue to step out.
audit.corrected: Wrote the shield into spikes[1].text, the reset tell into dosFull[0].d and wants.foe[2].
